items.headline: Retargeting springs mid-flight in CSS with linear()
items.summary: An interrupted drawer keeps its velocity by sampling current progress and building a new linear() easing. The article ships a 40-line helper that does it. The motion stays continuous without a JavaScript animation loop. The catch is that every interruption creates a new easing string, which the author has only tested in Chromium.

items.headline: Noise-driven gradient shaders with per-frame costs on mid-range phones
items.summary: Three noise functions produce soft interface gradients from one reusable GLSL snippet. A table lists the frame cost of each on mid-range phones. That makes it possible to choose a background by its cost before shipping it. The measurements cover two devices only.

items.headline: Radix navigation menu 2.1.0 adds safe-triangle hover intent
items.summary: Radix navigation menu 2.1.0 uses a safe triangle to decide hover intent in nested submenus. Focus also returns to the trigger when Escape closes a panel. A safe triangle is the area between the cursor and the submenu, where moving does not close it.

items.headline: Safe triangle cuts submenu mis-selections by 31 percent in a 48-person study
items.summary: A cursor study compares three ways of keeping a submenu open while the pointer travels to it. With 48 participants, the safe triangle cut mis-selections by 31 percent against a fixed delay. The result gives the pattern a measured basis. The study used a mouse only, so touch and trackpad are untested.

items.headline: Orbit 12 launches at 799 dollars with seven years of updates
items.summary: The Orbit 12 phone goes on sale on 16 October at 799 dollars, the same price as last year. It has a larger 5,200 mAh battery and seven years of software updates. The longer support answers new repair rules in Europe. The charger is still sold separately.
